debug_opts.description: Enable debug options. The argument is a comma-separated list of debug values: cfg, snpo, log, dir, base, tarp, fork, time. Empty string disables debugging.

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds. Standard is 300 (5 minutes). Must match cron/daemon schedule to avoid gaps or double-sampling.

log_errors.description: If true, write errors to the log file.

log_syslog.description: If true, send log messages to syslog.

targets.description: List of target definitions to monitor.

work_dir.description: Directory where MRTG stores generated HTML pages, graphs (PNGs), and log files. Must be writable by the MRTG user.
